Download the app and request a consultation from a Canadian-licensed doctor online at the tap of a button. No matter where you’re located in Canada, Maple connects you to a provider in minutes, 24/7. Fees apply for services that aren’t covered by provincial governments, though can be reimbursed if you have coverage from an insurer.
